name: reel-editor
description: Talking-head takes to finished Reels, TikToks and Shorts, as a Claude Code skill.

plugins.name: reel-editor
plugins.description: Cuts your takes to the speech and makes a Split Screen (default: vector graphics with real stock footage over your face), a Drawn Roadmap or a Talking Head, with sound, music, loudness and a QA pass. Runs locally.
